stemMd: Two materials cost 4 and 7 units per kilogram. A 10 kg mixture costs 55 units in total. How many kilograms of the more expensive material are used?
explanationMd: Let h be the higher-price mass. Then 7h+4(10−h)=55, giving 3h=15 and h=5 kg.

distractorRationale.a: This confuses the price per kilogram with the quantity.
